name: room_hover
note: determines what is under the mouse (room hotspot 19e6_1f8c, panel areas, lists 1980/1b50 ...) and computes hover id (7000 = panel TV, 3000+ = ads, ...) and tooltip rect (globals 0x8f88/0x8f8a/0x8f86, hover pos at DS:ec88/ec8a); calls hover_dispatch(id)

name: hover_dispatch
note: id 0 clears tooltip (screen flip); otherwise builds the tooltip / info card for the hovered object (big switch, ~19 cases: films, series, ads, news, ...); state in 0e80/0e82/0e84, 79ae, 79f8

name: channel_info_show
note: if DAT_79ae: (re)builds channel info card into bitmap DAT_8e6a (frame + channel_info_card_draw), then draw_sprite at (0x40,0x30)

name: money_tooltip_show
note: text_window_draw (0x11,9)-(0x19,0xd) with fmt(DAT_89a8, money_available(8b88)); Ghidra shows bogus extra args to money_available

name: channel_info_card_draw
note: info card for channel DAT_79de into dst: player/channel name, programme now (film/series title 775c/77f2 + genre, episode), ad (DS:3f2f), audience flags (5533), viewers (long 248f) formatted with fmt_money; architecture.md called it info_card_film

name: channel_programme_title_load
note: between minute 5 and 54: fetches title of the programme running on channel 79de (film text 2bd1_3024 / series 2bd1_30b8 + episode 2bd1_314c, loading via text cache 1433 if needed) into DS:775c / DS:77f2; clears DAT_7a40. architecture.md guessed tv_screen_update

name: ad_requirements_text_build
note: builds string (DS:ec8c) describing the ad customer's target conditions from record DS:3f2f+ad*24 (+0xc sign) using ad_targets_text_build

name: ad_targets_text_build
note: builds up to 3 target strings (genre names via text table 8370[+0x1a / +0x11a]) into DS:-0x70b4 table and combined DS:ec9c

name: tooltip_show_text
note: popup_box_show at hover rect (ec88,ec8a, size 8f8a x 8f86)

name: card_band_fill
c_signature: void card_band_fill(int16_t y, int16_t h, int16_t style)
note: 1dd5_16bd(0, y, width 8f8a, h, style, bitmap 8ec2): fills horizontal band of the info card

name: layout_box
note: box layout language: spec = 4 chars per line ("301 214 2-- ..."): char0 band style 1..3, char1 text slot 0..9 (strings at DS:-0x70b4), char2 font; creates popup box (popup_box_create) and fills bands + text

name: info_card_film_small
note: prepares strings for small film info card (title 2bd1_3024, 2bd1_306e, genre name, ...) size 0x11 x 0x0c
